name: Voxel Carving
definition: A technique to carve a voxel grid from a number of depth maps or silhouettes. It creates a dense, filled voxel grid of the given shape, unlike surface-only voxelization.
summary: Voxel carving reconstructs a dense 3D volume from 2D depth maps or silhouettes, differing from surface-only methods by explicitly filling the interior based on multi-view consistency.
